finally.en: The replication study finally confirmed the earlier finding that moderate doses improve recall.
finally.zh: 复制研究最终证实了先前关于中等剂量可改善记忆的发现。

finally.en: After years of dispute, the committee finally issued a formal statement on the matter.
finally.zh: 经过多年的争论，委员会终于就此事发表了正式声明。

finally.en: Only after the instruments were recalibrated did the sensor readings finally stabilize within the tolerance range.
finally.zh: 只有在仪器重新校准之后，传感器读数才终于稳定在容差范围之内。

broadly.en: Both studies broadly agree that the effect persists after controlling for demographic differences.
broadly.zh: 两项研究大体一致地认为，在控制人口学差异之后该效应依然存在。

broadly.en: The proposal was broadly supported by regional authorities, although funding details remained unresolved.
broadly.zh: 该提案得到了地方当局的广泛支持，尽管资金细节仍未解决。

broadly.en: Broadly speaking, the literature treats institutional trust as a precondition for compliance.
broadly.zh: 总体而言，文献把制度信任视为遵守规定的前提条件。

as well.en: The instrument measures reading comprehension as well as vocabulary size in secondary school pupils.
as well.zh: 该工具既能测量中学生的阅读理解水平，也能测量其词汇量。

as well.en: This approach reduces dropout rates as well as lowering the cost of each assessment.
as well.zh: 这一做法既能降低辍学率，也能减少每次评估的成本。

as well.en: Critics argued that the sample excluded rural households as well as very young children.
as well.zh: 批评者指出，该样本既排除了农村家庭，也排除了年龄极小的儿童。

at least.en: Participants completed at least three practice trials before the experimental block began.
at least.zh: 参与者在实验区组开始之前至少完成三次练习试次。

at least.en: The review found at least a dozen studies reporting a similar association in clinical cohorts.
at least.zh: 该综述发现至少有十余项研究在临床队列中报告了类似的关联。

at least.en: A reading age of at least eleven was required for entry into the longitudinal program.
at least.zh: 进入该纵向项目的条件是阅读年龄至少达到十一岁。

at most.en: Each respondent was allowed at most two questions in the follow-up interview.
at most.zh: 每位受访者在后续访谈中最多只能提出两个问题。

at most.en: The intervention may increase the sample at most by a small margin in rural districts.
at most.zh: 该干预措施至多只能使农村地区的样本小幅增加。

at most.en: Such a model would explain at most a modest share of the observed variation in attainment.
at most.zh: 这样的模型至多只能解释学业表现中已观测到的一小部分变异。

on the contrary.en: On the contrary, the follow-up survey found no evidence of the reported decline in engagement.
on the contrary.zh: 恰恰相反，后续调查并未发现所报道的参与度下降的证据。

on the contrary.en: The two traditions are not merely different; on the contrary, they imply incompatible standards of evidence.
on the contrary.zh: 这两种传统并非仅仅不同，恰恰相反，它们预设了互不相容的证据标准。

on the contrary.en: The policy did not merely fail to improve outcomes; on the contrary, it widened existing inequalities.
on the contrary.zh: 该政策不仅未能改善结果，恰恰相反，它还扩大了既有的不平等。

above all.en: Above all, the design must ensure that participants can withdraw without any penalty.
above all.zh: 最重要的是，实验设计必须确保参与者能够不受任何惩罚地退出。

above all.en: Above all, the report emphasizes the need for independent replication of its central claim.
above all.zh: 最重要的是，该报告强调需要对其核心论断进行独立的重复验证。

above all.en: The committee's recommendation reflects, above all, a concern for equitable access to public services.
above all.zh: 该委员会的建议首要地体现了对公共服务公平可及的关切。

after all.en: The intervention was modest, and after all it addressed a problem that had persisted for decades.
after all.zh: 该干预措施幅度有限，但它毕竟应对的是一个延续数十年的问题。

after all.en: After all, a measure of agreement is preferable to a prolonged dispute over terminology.
after all.zh: 毕竟，达成一定程度的共识总比围绕术语长期争论要好。

after all.en: It is unreasonable to dismiss the theory; after all, it accounts for a substantial share of the data.
after all.zh: 把这一理论弃置一旁是不合理的，毕竟它解释了数据中相当大的一部分。

if.en: If the sample size is insufficient, the estimator will produce misleadingly narrow confidence intervals.
if.zh: 如果样本量不足，估计量将产生具有误导性的过窄置信区间。

if.en: The grant can be renewed only if the investigators submit a detailed data management plan.
if.zh: 只有在研究者提交详细的数据管理计划时，该资助才能获得续期。

if.en: Replication remains difficult if raw materials and protocols are not publicly archived.
if.zh: 如果原始材料与实验方案未公开存档，重复验证仍然难以实现。

than.en: A longitudinal design yields stronger evidence than a single cross-sectional survey of attitudes.
than.zh: 纵向设计所获证据比单次的横断面态度调查更为有力。

than.en: Participants who received feedback performed better than those who received none.
than.zh: 获得反馈的参与者表现优于未获得反馈的参与者。

than.en: The revised scale was easier to administer than the earlier instrument had been.
than.zh: 修订后的量表比先前的工具更易于施测。

as.en: As the longitudinal dataset grows, estimates of regional inequality become progressively more stable.
as.zh: 随着纵向数据集的扩充，地区不平等的估计值逐渐趋于稳定。

as.en: As testing conditions changed over the decade, earlier scores cannot be directly compared with later ones.
as.zh: 由于十年间测试条件发生了变化，早期的分数无法与后期分数直接比较。

as.en: The gradient persisted as enrollment expanded into more rural districts across the region.
as.zh: 随着招生范围扩展到该地区更多的农村学区，这一梯度依然存在。

then.en: If the estimates converge, then the model can be accepted as an adequate description.
then.zh: 如果各项估计彼此收敛，那么该模型可以被接受为一种充分的描述。

then.en: The policy failed; then, what remained was to explain why implementation had diverged from design.
then.zh: 该政策失败了，那么剩下的便是解释为何执行偏离了原设计。

then.en: Suppose the estimates agree; then the conclusion is robust to a reasonable range of specifications.
then.zh: 假设各项估计彼此一致，那么结论对于合理范围内的模型设定是稳健的。

when.en: When the control variables were included, the association between exposure and outcome weakened substantially.
when.zh: 当纳入控制变量之后，暴露与结果之间的关联明显减弱。

when.en: Researchers must document when and why participants were excluded from the final analysis.
when.zh: 研究者必须说明参与者何时以及为何被排除在最终分析之外。

when.en: The reform was introduced when fiscal conditions made gradual adjustment politically feasible.
when.zh: 该改革是在财政条件使渐进调整在政治上变得可行之时引入的。
